anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Gradual convex curvature extending from the mid-thorax to the cranial-rostral junction.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Elongated, tapered conical projection with a length approximately three times its base width.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Highly obtuse angle where the melon slope transitions into the linear margins of the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Dorsal-perspective view showing symmetrical pectoral fins and horizontal tail flukes with a prominent central notch.
